## 📝 Description

A clear and concise description of the feature you're proposing.

### The following sections can be removed or amended as required

## 🎯 Problem Statement

Describe the problem this feature would solve. For example: "I'm always frustrated when..."

## 💭 Proposed Solution

Describe the solution you'd like to see implemented. Be as specific as possible.

## 🔄 Alternatives Considered

Describe any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## 📸 Mockups/Examples

If applicable, add mockups, screenshots, or links to similar features in other products.

## 📊 Business Impact

Explain how this feature would benefit users and the business.

## 📋 Additional Context

Add any other context about the feature request here.
